content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"An experienced worker can obtain formal recognition for skills learned outside a training course through the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 - Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) scheme [E01]. The process involves: (1) registering on the Skill India Digital platform [E02], (2) undergoing pre-screening by an Awarding Body to assess existing prior learning at no cost [E02], (3) completing a minimum of 30 hours of mandatory classroom orientation [E01], and (4) undergoing assessment and certification by NCVET-approved Awarding Bodies [E01]. Upon successful assessment, candidates receive an industry-relevant skill certificate [E01].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"The Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 - Recognition of Prior Learning scheme certifies candidates with prior-learning experience or skills","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Pre-screening is conducted at no cost to assess existing level of prior learning","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"Candidates must complete a minimum of 30 hours of mandatory classroom orientation","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Assessment and certification is conducted by NCVET-approved Awarding Bodies","evidence_ids":["E01"]}]}
